yates_mentzer.label: Modified Yates / Mentzer
yates_mentzer.note: Low volume, high intensity, reps-before-load, RPE 9-10. The current default.

hit.label: Pure HIT / Heavy Duty (Mentzer)
hit.note: One all-out set to failure, minimal volume, no backoffs, long rest, bigger jumps when earned.

volume.label: High-Volume Hypertrophy (GVT-style)
volume.note: More sets, moderate RPE 8-9, higher rep ranges, smaller load jumps.

strength_rpt.label: Strength 5x5 / Reverse Pyramid
strength_rpt.note: Lower reps, bigger load jumps, lower RPE caps, more warmups; backoffs as ~10% drops.

5_3_1.label: 5/3/1 (Jim Wendler)

anomalous_set_rep_gain_threshold.ratifying_authority: phase 06.3.1 decision D-03; plan 06.3.1-01 Task 2 checkpoint:decision (gate=blocking), option-a: 'D-02 = 0.25, D-03 = 0.50'
anomalous_set_rep_gain_threshold.note: The fraction of rep gain between a working set and its immediately preceding working set, where the later set's effective load is at or below the earlier set's, and the later set's RPE is at or below the earlier set's RPE, above which the later set is hard-excluded from progression anchoring as an anomalous outlier rather than blended into the top-set signal. Measured against live volm.duckdb by tools/measure_repeated_set_fatigue_decay.py: 370 qualifying pairs, 22 fires at >=50% = 5.9% fire rate -- deliberately conservative (25 percentage points of margin below the Day C Hanging Leg Raise repro's 75% gain), chosen because this constant's consequence (hard exclusion from progression anchoring) is harsher and less reversible than D-02's (a load reduction). Cleared comparison anchors: well under the 30% halt-threshold precedent set in phases 06.2/06.3, and confirmed to fire on the Day C Hanging Leg Raise audit repro (8@9 then 14@8: same/lower load, lower RPE (8<=9), gain=(14-8)/8=75%, fires at 50%). Comparison basis for the D-03 detector: a later working set whose effective load is at or below an earlier working set's, whose RPE is at or below that earlier set's, and whose reps exceed that earlier set's by at least this fraction. anomalous_cluster.supersession: D-03 (06.3.1-CONTEXT.md, phase 06.3.1 plan 06.3.1-04) superseded by P-06 (06.3.1.1.1.1-CONTEXT.md), ratified 2026-09-23, Chad Crawford / Program Director
anomalous_cluster.note: P-06 (anomalous_set_detection) majority-cluster filter, consumed by _coherent_cluster()/_filter_anomalous_sets() (tools/prescribe_hypertrophy.py). D-03 (06.3.1-CONTEXT.md, phase 06.3.1 plan 06.3.1-04) superseded by P-06 (06.3.1.1.1.1-CONTEXT.md), ratified 2026-09-23, Chad Crawford / Program Director. D-03 anchored on one comparison set (the highest-effective-load entry) and hard-excluded any LATER set that beat it on reps at equal-or-lower load and RPE; on the real Day C Hanging Leg Raise occurrence [8@9, 17@8, 15@9, 12@9] that excluded the three mutually-coherent sets and kept only the isolated 8@9. P-06 reverses the anchoring direction: the dominant coherent cluster survives, the isolated observation is the outlier, even when it is the nominal top set. ALGORITHM (O(N), no subset search): (1) partition working sets by effective load (`_eff()`, so band-assisted inversion holds) -- the mode-load group (most sets; ties toward the group holding the latest set) is the candidate pool; a set at a different effective load is ALWAYS kept, never an outlier, even when that load difference is a data-entry error (the Program Director confirmed this narrowing of P-06's locked wording on 2026-09-23, with its measured cost); a set with any missing lbs/reps/rpe is always kept and never a coherence reference. (2) connect consecutive pool sets when |reps_i - reps_j| / max(reps_i, reps_j, 1) <= cluster_tolerance and |rpe_i - rpe_j| <= 1.0 (the same comparable-effort band as _repeated_set_fatigue_pair_ids()). (3) the LONGEST contiguous run is the cluster; a tie goes to the run holding the latest set (a more recent state is more representative of current capacity). (4) Everything else in the pool is excluded, PROVIDED the cluster holds at least 2 sets: with no coherent adjacent pair there is no cluster and nothing is excluded (implementation-time amendment 2026-09-23, plan 06 Task 2: without it D-02's own Day B repro 165x9@9,137.5x9@9,137.5x6@9 lost a set to a cluster_size=1 'exclusion' and the frozen Day A characterization gained the same spurious exclusion; the disagreement rates quoted below (28.9% / 67.2%) were ratified from the plan-02 instrument, which has no such floor; re-measured over the same 483 occurrences WITH the floor, at cluster_tolerance=0.20 the old and new rule pick a different outlier in 14/152 = 9.2% of N=3 and 22/58 = 37.9% of N>=4 occurrences. The floor is one structural constant, _MIN_COHERENT_CLUSTER_SIZE, and is flagged for Program Director confirmation in 06.3.1.1.1.1-06-SUMMARY.md). min_working_sets = 3: below it (N=2) the pre-existing D-03 pairwise rule applies unchanged via anomalous_set_rep_gain_threshold. MEASURED by tools/measure_anomalous_cluster_shape.py (06.3.1.1.1.1-MEASUREMENTS.md section P-06) over 495 historical occurrences with >=1 working set (11 N=1, 273 N=2, 152 N=3, 49 N=4, 9 N=5); the old-rule-vs-new-rule disagreement covers the 483 with N>=2. At cluster_tolerance=0.20: N=2 18/273 = 6.6%, N=3 44/152 = 28.9%, N>=4 39/58 = 67.2% pick a different outlier. N=2 is the lowest-disagreement, most-ambiguous bucket at every candidate tolerance (5.1%-13.6%) because 'majority' is undefined with two sets, so min_working_sets=3 is the smallest N with a genuine majority/minority split; 0.20 keeps N=3 a real behavior change while N=2 stays low. Confidence: moderate -- one historical population, tolerance is a judgment call between 0.15 and 0.30. Reversibility: costly (reverting means re-deriving which live occurrences depended on the old anchoring). A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.

isolation_load_jump.ratifying_authority: phase 06.3.1.1.1.1 decision P-03 (06.3.1.1.1.1-CONTEXT.md); plan 06.3.1.1.1.1-02 Task 3 checkpoint:decision (gate=blocking), option-a: 'ratify every recommended value as measured' -- see 06.3.1.1.1.1-02-SUMMARY.md's Ratification Record for the full citation, this exact value pair, and the measured fire-rate table this plan (06.3.1.1.1.1-04) cites rather than re-deriving.
isolation_load_jump.note: max_pct_increase (10%) and min_predicted_reps (8) together bound a single isolation load-jump step: an increase is permitted only when its percentage rise is at or below max_pct_increase AND _reps_after_load_jump()'s predicted lower-bound rep target is at or above min_predicted_reps (or the exercise's own profile-TYPE min_predicted_reps override, when present -- P-03's 'unless the exercise's profile explicitly permits lower-rep work' clause). Measured against live volm.duckdb by tools/measure_isolation_load_jump.py: 125 qualifying isolation increase_load occurrences (LOADED loading types only -- barbell/dumbbell/cable_or_machine, the only branch _reps_after_load_jump() is called from). cap=7.5% and cap=10% are measured-identical (94/125 = 75.2% blocked in both -- no historical jump falls between them), so 10% is the least-restrictive choice within the PRD's own stated 5-10% range that changes nothing versus 7.5%; cap=5% is measurably more aggressive (81.6% blocked) and would over-correct jumps that are already reasonable at the smallest available equipment increment. floor=8 (89/125 = 71.2% blocked) is chosen over floor=10 (90/125 = 72.0% blocked, a 1-occurrence difference) as the PRD's own literal number ('never accept a load increase whose predicted resulting rep count falls below 8'). A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.

qc_issue_severity.note: Per-issue-code severity tier consumed by _qc_severity_for_issue()/_qc_status_from_issues() (tools/prescribe_hypertrophy.py). qc_status keeps its existing two-value contract ("pass"/"fail"); this map supplies the additive Prescription.qc_severity field's five-way distinction without changing what build_card_data.format_qc_tag() reads. set_role_conflict is P-10 category (2) present-but-misclassified: plan 05.1-02 (ratified 2026-08-15) already repairs the misclassification by promoting the set into the prescription's own working-set selection before validate() ever runs, so the QC code is downgraded to warn -- it is a display-only advisory about the input label, not a defect in the prescribed numbers. reference_resolution_fallback (added phase 06.3.1.1.1.1 plan 03, ratified 2026-09-22) is P-10 category (3), "reference-resolution failure": P-01's fallback chain (exact -> exact_relaxed -> cluster -> fail-closed) resolves this code to warn per P-01's own explicit "warn, continue" requirement -- the prescription it accompanies is a real, defensible one built from real performed data, never a hard failure; only the terminal fail-closed case (insufficient_reference_input, unchanged by this addition) still hard-fails. isolation_load_jump_capped (added phase 06.3.1.1.1.1 plan 04, ratified 2026-09-23) is P-10 category (4), "physiologically implausible prescription" made SAFE rather than fired as a hard failure: a capped jump is a deliberate, inspectable hold/chase-reps decision, not a defect, so it is downgraded to warn -- the athlete still gets a defensible, real prescription, and the blocked limit (percentage or predicted reps) is named in the code's own payload. Any issue-code prefix absent from this map resolves to fail (_qc_severity_for_issue()'s fail-closed-by-omission default): a future code added without a deliberate severity choice must behave exactly as it does today (hard QC failure), never silently downgrade. 06.2's D-02 dropped_working_set is explicitly NOT downgraded by this phase -- it keeps fail, matching 06.2-CONTEXT.md's ratified QC-visibility-only posture, which this phase is scoped out of reopening. bloodflow_plausibility_recompute and bloodflow_plausibility_undetermined (added phase 06.3.1.1.1.1 plan 05, P-04, ratified 2026-09-23) are P-10 category (4), "physiologically implausible prescription" made SAFE: a recompute that reached a coherent load is a deliberate, inspectable correction, and an undetermined result (reference data missing) keeps the already-vetted ratified percentage while making the unchecked state visible -- both warn. bloodflow_plausibility_floor_exhausted (same plan) is the deliberate exception and is FAIL tier, citing P-04's own defensibility requirement directly: the descent reached the policy floor and the load is STILL incoherent against the demonstrated reference, so the shipped prescription does not pass plausibility, and a warn-tier code cannot honestly describe an outcome the gate itself calls implausible (codex plan-review correction, 2026-09-22, round 4). A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.

bloodflow_plausibility.ratifying_authority: phase 06.3.1.1.1.1 decision P-04 (06.3.1.1.1.1-CONTEXT.md); plan 06.3.1.1.1.1-02 Task 3 checkpoint:decision (gate=blocking), option-a: 'ratify every recommended value as measured' -- see 06.3.1.1.1.1-02-SUMMARY.md's Ratification Record (rpe_tolerance=0.5; min_load_fraction_of_candidate=0.5, assigned directly by the Program Director as a policy default). Consumed by plan 06.3.1.1.1.1-05.
bloodflow_plausibility.note: P-04 (bloodflow_rpe_coherence) blood-flow plausibility gate, consumed by _bloodflow_load_is_coherent()/_plausible_bloodflow_load() (tools/prescribe_hypertrophy.py). MODEL: a monotonic coherence check, NOT an RPE prediction (codex plan-review correction, 2026-09-22, HIGH -- dimensional error: _PCT_LOAD_PER_REP/_rep_cost_of_jump() estimate the REP cost of a load change, and nothing in this codebase converts rep-equivalents to RPE points, so inverting them would invent unmeasured physiology). A candidate is implausible only when it claims MORE load, at the SAME OR MORE reps, will cost strictly LESS effort than ref_rpe - rpe_tolerance; no RPE value is predicted or fabricated. rpe_tolerance = 0.5 RPE points, a boundary-noise margin (not a predicted-RPE tolerance). Measured by tools/measure_bloodflow_plausibility.py against 10 qualifying default-profile bloodflow occurrences with a resolvable reference exposure: 0/10 = 0.0% monotonicity violations at rpe_tolerance 0, 0.5 and 1.0 alike (06.3.1.1.1.1-MEASUREMENTS.md section P-04). This is a structural, sample-uninformative tie, stated as such: the ratified working_pct_of_primary_top 0.667 can never produce a prescribed load above the reference load, so the data cannot discriminate among candidates; 0.5 was ratified as the conservative middle of the swept range, protective against a future case (a percentage at or above 1.0, or an unusually low reference RPE) this history cannot exercise. Confidence: low as a measurement, adequate as a safety margin. 0 barbell-loading-type bloodflow occurrences exist in history, so the barbell path is untested against real data. min_load_fraction_of_candidate = 0.5 is an engineering-judgment POLICY DEFAULT, explicitly NOT a measured value (no historical data measures how far a load must descend): the descent floor, expressed as a fraction of the ORIGINAL CANDIDATE the gate started from, never of the reference load (a fraction <=1 of the reference can never itself fail coherence, so it could never bind -- codex plan-review correction, round 2). The gate is ONE-DIRECTIONAL: it can only lower a load, so the percentages ratified 2026-08-26 against Golden Test Case 1 (working_pct_of_primary_top 0.667; the barbell 0.75 override) remain the ceiling and their pinned values stay reachable. Three distinct outcomes, three QC codes (see qc_issue_severity): recompute (warn), undetermined (warn), floor_exhausted (fail). A change here supersedes a ratified value -- edit only with a new, explicit ratification, not silently.
